init.title: Molly & Cody Smart Feeder Options
init.description: Configure anti-clog verification, hopper tracking, alert behavior, and modular compute toggles (disable heavy video/vision tasks on low-power Raspberry Pi / HAOS boxes while keeping lightweight 8 kHz audio anti-clog verification active).

enable_verification.name: Audio Anti-Clog Verification (Lightweight 8 kHz Motor vs. Kibble Audio — Recommended for All HAOS Boxes)

enable_vision_verification.name: Visual Inner-Bowl Analysis (Optional OpenCV/Pillow Camera ROI — Higher Compute)

feed.name: Feed Portions
feed.description: Dispense 1 to 20 portions of kibble immediately (with optional camera and microphone anti-clog verification).

verify_feed.name: Feed & Verify
verify_feed.description: Dispense kibble while recording 8 kHz audio and optional before/after bowl frames to verify kibble impacts and detect clogs.

check_bowl.name: Check Bowl
check_bowl.description: Capture an on-demand bowl snapshot and run computer-vision kibble fill inspection without dispensing food.

set_schedule_slot.name: Set Schedule Slot
set_schedule_slot.description: Modify one of the 8 feeder meal schedule slots (DP 207) without disturbing the other slots.

set_schedule_raw.name: Set Raw Schedule (DP 207)
set_schedule_raw.description: Write a raw 15-character-per-slot ASCII hex schedule string directly to DP 207.

sync_schedules.name: Sync Schedules from Feeder
sync_schedules.description: Pull DP 207 from the feeder, decode all schedule slots, and re-arm pre-meal verification timers.

refill_hopper.name: Refill Hopper
refill_hopper.description: Record a hopper refill in SQLite and reset the remaining hopper capacity to 100%.

capture_snapshot.name: Capture Bowl Snapshot
capture_snapshot.description: Capture an upright 720x1280 JPEG snapshot from the feeder camera via Cloud imm P2P.

play_tts.name: Play TTS on Feeder Speaker
play_tts.description: Synthesize speech and stream 8 kHz G.711 mu-law talkback frames (reqId=7) to the feeder speaker.

play_audio.name: Play Audio File on Feeder Speaker
play_audio.description: Stream a local WAV or MP3 audio file to the feeder speaker via Cloud imm P2P (reqId=7).

play_chime.name: Play Dinner Chime
play_chime.description: Play the built-in two-tone dinner chime on the feeder speaker.

set_dp.name: Set Tuya Data Point (DP)
set_dp.description: Write a raw Tuya Data Point (DP) value to the feeder over Local LAN or Cloud.

run_online_check.name: Run Pre-Meal Online Check
run_online_check.description: Poll feeder connectivity over LAN/Cloud, ping optional healthcheck heartbeat, and alert if offline.

clear_clog_alert.name: Clear Clog Alert
clear_clog_alert.description: Reset active clog and weak-flow alert flags back to normal (ok).
